# Eval-Driven Development

> TDD for AI agents that call tools. Write evals, mock MCP schemas, assert routing, gate PRs, and turn production misses into the next case.

## What this site is
Eval-Driven Development (EDD) is the same red → green → refactor loop as TDD, applied to prompts and tool schemas. The harness ships in Agent Lifecycle Kit (`kit eval run|ci|report`). The same kit also gates always-on context (`kit measure-context`), composes one MCP profile, and runs `kit check`.

## Install
```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mzworthington/agent-lifecycle-kit/main/install.sh | bash
kit init . --mcp default --hook
```

## Commands
```
kit eval run --suite evals/edd/architecture_routing.yaml --model scripted
kit eval ci --threshold-routing 95 --out out/reports
kit eval report --format md --out out/reports
kit measure-context
kit check
kit mcp default --install
```
